topic_thesis: Cheering for ₹30,000/gram gold or hyped pre-IPO multipliers is a trap because astronomical nominal gains only occur alongside brutal inflation that destroys middle-class purchasing power.
strategic_angle: Expose the 'Nominal Return Illusion' peddled by hype-merchants: finfluencers promise a 4x windfall on gold or unlisted shares, conveniently hiding that if gold quadruples rapidly, hyperinflation means your ₹20 morning filter coffee and monthly groceries will spike by 10x, leaving your net real wealth in the negative.
key_statistic: ₹30,000/gram gold target (328% nominal spike) vs 65% real purchasing power collapse across household expenses
target_emotion: Sobering realization and cynical skepticism toward hyper-bullish financial targets
